svg.title: PROJECTS still brewing in my garage..
svg.desc: The pale pixel ghost from the Resident stands beside a square iron cauldron that brews green potion over a small fire in a haunted Minecraft garage. Pixel bubbles rise and pop. Three potion bottles, a brewing stand, cobweb, pumpkin and dark doorway surround the still sign. Only bubbles, the potion ripple, fire cores and pumpkin face animate.
